gate: RTK C9 HMT lambda=1 round-S3 spatial-diffeomorphism FP operator and zero-mode audit
scope: On the same frozen round-S3, D=3, lambda=1, zero-background-momentum projectable HMT background, make one prospective explicit spatial gauge choice and derive the linearized spatial-diffeomorphism Faddeev-Popov operator. Separate transverse-vector and longitudinal-scalar harmonics and classify residual Killing/trivial global zero modes. This gate does not compute a zeta-regularized FP determinant, does not combine FP with the prior FS factor, does not construct the physical TT Hessian, and does not evaluate a one-loop effective action.

prospective_spatial_gauge.name: spatial DeWitt/harmonic gauge
prospective_spatial_gauge.reason_for_beta_one_half: The coefficient 1/2 is frozen before evaluation because it cancels the mixed nabla_i nabla_j xi^j term in delta F_i, giving a Laplace-type vector FP operator and an explicit residual-isometry kernel on the fixed round-S3 background.

frozen_harmonic_conventions.transverse_vector: nabla^i V_i^T=0 and -nabla^2 V_i^T=[q_l^2-1]/a^2 V_i^T, l=1,2,...
frozen_harmonic_conventions.scalar_gradient_generator: xi_i^L=nabla_i Y_l; the l=0 gradient vanishes identically

required_exact_derivations: Derive delta_xi F_i from the frozen gauge variation and the covariant-derivative commutator; the result must be M_i^j xi_j=(nabla^2 delta_i^j+R_i^j)xi_j on the fixed background.
For transverse vector harmonics, derive M V_i^T=[3-q_l^2]/a^2 V_i^T. Verify l=1 is the only transverse zero-eigenvalue harmonic level and l>=2 is nonzero.

Verify the l=1 transverse-vector multiplicity is six and classify this kernel as the six Killing-vector generators of round S3; these are residual spatial isometries, not physical TT modes and not a new FS second-class factor.

For longitudinal generators xi_i=nabla_i Y_l, derive M nabla_i Y_l=[4-q_l^2]/a^2 nabla_i Y_l. Verify every nontrivial l>=1 longitudinal harmonic is nonzero; l=0 is not a ghost zero mode because nabla_i Y_0=0 identically.

Connect to the certified l=1 conformal gauge witness: for h_ij=f g_ij with l=1 and xi_i=-(a^2/2)nabla_i f, verify delta_xi g_ij=f g_ij and F_i[f g]=M_i^j xi_j=-(1/2)nabla_i f. Therefore the prior l=1 conformal direction is gauge-fixed by the nonzero longitudinal FP block, not part of the residual Killing kernel.
Keep the projectable time-reparametrization/lapse sector global and outside this local spatial FP operator.
Keep the frozen local HMT U(1) nu=0 FP factor separate and field-independent; do not merge it with the spatial FP operator.
Keep TT tensor gravitons in the physical Hessian sector and do not compute their determinant in this gate.
pass_condition: All frozen exact identities and harmonic classifications hold: the selected round-S3 spatial gauge gives M=nabla^2+Ricci, its transverse kernel consists exactly of the six l=1 Killing generators, its nontrivial longitudinal spectrum has no zero eigenvalue, the l=0 scalar gradient is identically absent rather than a ghost zero mode, and the earlier l=1 conformal witness is consistently gauge-fixed by the longitudinal block. No determinant product or one-loop closure may be claimed.
fail_condition: Any frozen operator identity, harmonic eigenvalue, multiplicity, zero-mode classification, or l=1 conformal-witness consistency check fails; or the audit conflates residual Killing modes, projectable time gauge, HMT U(1), FS second-class factors, or physical TT Hessians.
